title: Whispers at the Gate
text:
*Patience is a virtue few travelers possess. You settle in to wait, keeping your ears open. The people around you talk freely, assuming you are just another road-worn nobody.*

Merchant Woman: "Three ships overdue from Kerhold. My husband says it's pirates, but I've heard... other things."

Old Farmer: "Aye, and what about old Aldric's shop? Ransacked in broad daylight, they say. Guards did nothing."

Merchant Woman: "The Duke's been ill. No one's steering the ship, if you take my meaning."

*By the time you reach the gate, you know more about Ashenmoor's troubles than most of its citizens. The guard barely glances at your papers before waving you through.*

*The city beyond is exactly as troubled as the whispers suggested — shuttered windows, nervous faces, and the smell of something burning somewhere far off.*

choices.text: Seek out Aldric's ransacked shop — it sounds important
Head to the market square and get your bearings
